Row.Text: Controller map tools, stacked-unit cycling and settlement shortcuts. Optional stick compatibility can be switched on or off in Options → Add-ons → Better Controller Support. City/unit/wonder lists require Map Trix; map tacks require Detailed Map Tacks.
更好的手柄支持 · Better Controller Support
手柄地图工具、同格单位切换和定居点快捷入口。可在“选项 → 附加内容 → 更好的手柄支持”手动开关摇杆兼容。城市／单位／奇观列表需要 Map Trix；地图钉需要 Detailed Map Tacks。
